analyzed: dhyāna pāramitā prabhāvita vipaśyanā pramāṇa niyamaḥ vimūḍheṣu sattveṣu bhūmi antara anukūla dṛṣṭiṣu ca pṛthagjana śrāvaka paryāpanneṣu aupalambhika bodhisattveṣu ca maitrī ādibhiḥ sarva śūnyatā prabheda gocarāyāḥ prādhānyena anavakāra śūnyatā ādi catuṣka ālambanāyāḥ prajñāpāramitāyāḥ sarva ākāra jña tā abhimukhībhāva niyamāt tatas eva ca iyam ṣaṣṭhī bodhisattva bhūmiḥ

analyzed: daurmanasya prahāṇa asādhāraṇam pūrvavat bodhisattvasya tu sarvatra yathā ukta vaipulya ādi yogena syām avasthāyām sarva dharma śūnyatā upasaṃhāre sati ātyantika sva para artha adhikāreṇa sarva tathāgata raśmi abhiṣeka āśraya tvena niruttara prabhāva dharma upadeśa āśrayā sambuddha bhūmi praveśe vajra upama samādhi bhūmi paryantā daśamī bhūmiḥ
